Alert to homeowners — MV Realty contract cancellation period
Recorder Sarah Turner is making homeowners aware of a one-time cancellation window for Homeowner Benefit Agreements with MV Realty of Ohio, LLC. Homeowners who wish to cancel must notify MV Realty by April 29, 2026 .
Read the full notice (PDF document)
Services
The Pickaway County Recorder is Sarah Turner who took office on January 6th, 2025. The Recorders Office provides the following services:
Make a complete, accurate and permanent record of every document pertaining to the conveyance and encumbrance of land within the county.
Maintains permanent land records, retains them in archival form, and make them constantly accessible to the public.
Enforces more than 1000 sections of state law in the Ohio Revised Code pertaining to the duties of the Recorder’s Office.
Takes great care to ensure that every document received is accurately filed, recorded and indexed.
Serves on the county’s RECORDS COMMISSION which authorizes the retention of county records and determines when or how these government records may be disposed.
Serves on the county’s AUTOMATIC DATA PROCESSING BOARD* to authorize any purchase, lease, or contract for data processing equipment for county offices.
Serves as secretary and chief administrator of the county’s MICROFILMING BOARD* to authorize any purchase, lease or contract for microfilming equipment in county offices and to oversee the operation of the county’s microfilming center and services.
Collects fees for documents filed in the Recorder’s office and pays these monies into the county’s general fund.
Maintain an accurate record of all monies appropriated to the Recorder’s office for its operation.
Performs all accounting functions necessary to the operation of the Recorder’s office including preparation of annual budgets and reports, vouchers, purchase orders, etc., and maintains all payroll records, sick and vacation leave records and other records pertaining to the Recorder’s staff.
Files annually an ethics report, inventory of office equipment, affirmative action report, depository agreements for funds and every other report as required by law.
Notifies boards of county commissioners and township trustees annually of their duty to file zoning resolutions, maps and amendments.
Pickaway County Recorder Sarah Turner alerts homeowners on MV Realty Contract Cancellation Period
Office of the Pickaway County Recorder · February 19, 2026
Full text of the notice, provided so the content can be read with a screen reader. The PDF is the official record.
Pickaway County homeowners — A notice was recently issued by the Ohio Attorney General’s Office regarding Homeowner Benefit Agreements (“HBA”) (or a related memorandum) with MV Realty of Ohio, LLC (“MV Realty”).
In October 2023, Ohio enacted R.C. 5301.94, which identifies certain exclusive residential listing practices, such as the HBA, as unfair or deceptive and in violation of the Ohio Consumer Sales Practices Act, R.C. 1245.01. Although agreements signed prior to the law’s effective date were not automatically voided, the Attorney General’s resolution with MV Realty created a one-time cancellation window for affected homeowners statewide.
Per the notice, certain Ohio homeowners with an HBA with MV Realty have a limited-time opportunity to cancel these agreements, without repaying any upfront moneys received at the time the HBA was signed. Under this offer, homeowners must notify MV Realty of their intent to cancel by April 29, 2026, and pay a one-time $75 fee. MV Realty is then required to record a termination document with the county recorder, releasing the previously recorded HBA.
The Recorder’s Office is not authorized to evaluate or enforce private contracts and cannot provide legal advice. However, considering the Ohio Attorney General’s cancellation offer, Turner wants residents to be aware of the deadline. If you believe you may have a recorded agreement and may be affected, you may use our online document search to review records on file with the Recorder’s Office at www.pickawaycountyrecorder.com (opens in a new window on an external website) .
We encourage you to carefully review any correspondence related to the cancellation offer you have or may receive from MV Realty and/or the AG before taking any action. If you have questions, consult an attorney.
If you believe you have a contract with MV Realty that was never recorded, please contact the AG for further consumer guidance.
Sincerely,
Sarah Turner
Pickaway County Recorder
This notice is being provided for informational purposes only. Additional information regarding this and other consumer related matters, including official consumer guidance and contact details, is available on the AG’s website at OhioAttorneyGeneral.gov (opens in a new window on an external website) . You may also email the AG with questions regarding this matter at MVRInquiries@OhioAGO.gov or consult with a private attorney.
